description: Fired when the user presses Save on a dirty draft. Persist event.holiday with system.user.editHoliday (or addHoliday when isNew; on a rename — oldName present — edit under the old name with the new model) and refresh the data.holidays binding.

holiday.description: The flat HolidayModel mirror: { name, date: 'YYYY-MM-DD', repeatAnnually }.

isNew.description: True when this save comes from the create flow (persist with system.user.addHoliday).

oldName.description: Present only on a rename: the holiday's previous name (pass it as editHoliday's first argument).
